overview: The India Electronics Week Innovation Challenge is a scheme under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) aimed at fostering innovation in the electronics sector. It invites participation from startups, companies, and innovators to showcase and develop cutting-edge electronic technologies. The challenge is part of MeitY's broader initiatives to strengthen India's electronics manufacturing and innovation ecosystem.
objectives: Promote innovation in electronics and allied technologies
Provide a platform for startups and innovators to showcase solutions
Encourage development and commercialization of indigenous electronic technologies
Facilitate industry-academia collaboration in electronics R&D
eligibility: Open to Indian companies, startups, innovators, and technology developers working in the electronics sector. Participants must be registered entities in India with relevant innovations in electronics, IoT, embedded systems, or related domains.
benefits: Recognition at India Electronics Week, opportunity to showcase innovations to industry leaders and investors, potential for technology transfer or collaboration, access to MeitY's network of electronics ecosystem stakeholders, and visibility in national electronics innovation forums.
financial_support: The scheme primarily offers non-financial benefits such as recognition, networking, and platform exposure. Direct financial support like grants or seed funding is not explicitly mentioned in the available evidence.
application_process: 1. Visit the MeitY Schemes and Services portal. 2. Locate the India Electronics Week Innovation Challenge under ongoing schemes. 3. Register on the designated application portal. 4. Submit innovation details including technology description, use case, and team information. 5. Await evaluation by the expert committee. 6. Selected participants will be notified for participation in India Electronics Week.
required_documents: Any relevant IP or patent information
deadlines: Rolling basis — specific dates for India Electronics Week Innovation Challenge are announced periodically on the MeitY portal.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
contact_details: Email: ceo-dibd@digitalindia.gov.in (general MeitY contact for scheme inquiries)
caveats: Financial support is not guaranteed and depends on evaluation outcomes
Participation does not assure funding or commercialization support
Applicants must ensure their innovations comply with relevant Indian regulations
Selection is based on novelty, feasibility, and potential impact
